description: This is a database migration script using Alembic for fixing data access permissions related to virtual datasets in the Superset project. It defines ORM models, performs database queries, and updates permission entries.

classes.name: Permission
classes.description: ORM model representing permissions in the database.

classes.name: ViewMenu
classes.description: ORM model representing view menus, with equality methods.

classes.name: Role
classes.description: ORM model representing user roles with associated permissions.

classes.name: PermissionView
classes.description: ORM model linking permissions and view menus.

classes.name: Database
classes.description: ORM model for database connection info.

classes.name: SqlaTable
classes.description: ORM model representing database tables, with permission generation method.

methods.name: upgrade
methods.description: Migration function that fixes faulty permissions for virtual datasets by updating view menu names and removing orphaned permissions.
